scope:
Reviewed source code, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform IAM config, CI/CD workflows, MCP configuration, approval system, budget enforcement, shell tool restrictions, network policies, image signing and admission control, Dockerfile, systemd services, .mcp.json credentials handling. Reviewed: app source code (src/*.ts), Dockerfile, Kubernetes deployment and policies, release workflow, tool policy, CODEOWNERS, release manifest, system and subagent prompts, MCP configuration, package.json, and config files. Not reviewed: platform infrastructure (IAM policies, drift detection, bucket lifecycle, emergency procedures, rollback logic). 
Reviewed code in /src, /infra, /.mcp.json, /package.json, /.github/workflows for:
- External tool and MCP server dependencies
- Version pinning and vulnerability scanning
- Tool fingerprint verification
- Tool metadata scanning
- Sub-agent credential delegation
- Stop signal propagation
- Audit record completeness and integrity
- Network policies and egress control

What was NOT reviewed (outside repo):
- Actual audit pipeline integrity and retention (configured outside repo)
- Fleet-level deployment tracking and incident response (in platform layer)
- Real network policy enforcement (K8s cluster control plane)
- Vendor evidence for MCP servers and services
- Identity provider and OAuth client issuer verification (platform)
 TypeScript/Node.js agent harness. Reviewed: src/ (index.ts webhook, worker.ts loop, audit.ts logging, killswitch.ts, memory.ts, permissions.ts, budget.ts, approvals.ts, subagents.ts, tools/), config.ts, README. Not reviewed: MCP servers, tests, CI workflows, deployment infra.
